devServer.evidence: HTTP 200 on GET /, GET /presenter/, 11 slides render at /1..11

build.command: npm run build (scripts/build.mjs derives the Pages base from GITHUB_REPOSITORY; SLIDEV_BASE overrides it)

pdfExport.requiredExtraInstall: npm install -D playwright-chromium (Slidev's PDF exporter uses Playwright and refused to run until playwright-chromium was installed in this project)

pptxExport.verifiedVia: reading ppt/slides/slide*.xml entries in the .pptx zip => 11 slide parts
pptxExport.notes: PPTX export completed without error. Each slide is exported as a rasterized image inside a PowerPoint slide (this is Slidev's documented approach), so text is not editable inside PowerPoint and speaker notes from the .md HTML comments are NOT carried across into the .pptx notes pane. Layout and visuals match the deck exactly.

presenterMode.keyboardShortcut: Press 'p' while viewing a slide to toggle a presenter mode opens in a new tab; the presenter view itself is a first-class route
presenterMode.evidence: Playwright loaded /presenter/1, found speaker notes DOM containing the English narration for slide 1: 'Hi everyone. I want to share one simple idea today.' + 'The products we build now serve two users: the person at the keyboard, and the AI acting on that person\'s behalf.' etc. Screenshot at review/presenter-slide-01.png shows current slide, next slide preview, and speaker notes pane.

speakerNotes.method: trailing HTML comment block <!-- ... --> at the end of each slide's markdown section (Slidev's documented speaker-notes syntax)
speakerNotes.verifiedVia: regex count of <!-- --> blocks in slides.md === 11; presenter route rendered the notes text for slide 1 as HTML paragraphs
speakerNotes.englishNarrationSource: script.json 'say.primary' lines grouped by the immediately preceding 'ask' segment (SLIDE 1..11), concatenated in order as separate paragraphs

knownLimitations: PPTX slides are rasterized images of each slide (Slidev's documented behavior); text is not editable inside PowerPoint, and speaker notes are not propagated into the PowerPoint notes pane. If you need PowerPoint-native notes, keep the .md as the source of truth and use the PDF for handout distribution.

The default Slidev PDF exporter is Playwright-based and required an extra `npm install -D playwright-chromium` in this project even though a system-wide Playwright install exists at the repo root — Slidev only resolves it from its own node_modules.

Slidev prints console 'Wake Lock permission request denied' errors in headless Chromium. These are harmless browser-API warnings (Wake Lock requires a user gesture) and do not affect rendering. Not treated as fixable content errors.

found: PAGEERROR: Wake Lock permission request denied (once per slide route, 12 total across 11 slides + presenter)
consoleErrors.reason: Wake Lock API is a browser-only Web API that requires a real user gesture; the warning does not occur in an interactive browser session and cannot be suppressed from Slidev source. No real page-content errors were found.

overflow.verifiedVia: For each of slides 1..11 in the dev server, measured .slidev-page scrollHeight vs clientHeight and scrollWidth vs clientWidth at 1600x900; no slide exceeded the viewport.
